name: Kurune Kokuri
source: A prank-liker Tenrou who was summoned through Kokkuri by mistake. Well, since she already got summoned, she decided amuse herself by investigating the seven wonders of mystery with you.
translation: A prank-liker Tenrou who was summoned through Kokkuri by mistake. Well, since she already got summoned, she decided amuse herself by investigating the seven wonders of mystery with you.
